comparison.objective: Seat an add-on board onto two rows of header pins without bending them, versus collet-nut preassembly.
comparison.physical_skill: Multi-pin parallel alignment and controlled axial pressing; candidate requires marked eccentric entry and changing-axis tilt-roll snap engagement.
comparison.success_condition: Board must be fully seated, pins unbent, released and still; candidate requires retained collet plus withdrawal verification and forbids direct axial forcing. Candidate force threshold is missing.
comparison.reason: Both are precision insertions, but they test materially different alignment and force strategies.
